title: How to Sign Up Broternet
content:
Before use Broternet, you need Bro Network
1) Go to 192.168.1.10:8080
2) Press the "Sign Up"
3) You will give a ID user
This ID will use in Broternet to backend know you
4) Enjoy

Fact: Your ID user is the last digit of your IP
Ex: Your IP is 192.168.1.56
Backend will take 56 at ID
you need to connect the "adb local network"
